author: Logos II
title: E34: Siamese DSConv with Attention Interaction for CRI-Off
abstract: This experiment tests a novel architecture specifically designed for the bipartite structure of the CRI-Off dataset. It uses a Siamese DSConv backbone to encode the sgRNA and target sequences in parallel. Instead of global pooling, it then uses an attention mechanism to model the interaction between the two encoded sequences, with the pooled sgRNA representation querying the target sequence features. The hypothesis is that this strong inductive bias will lead to a significant improvement on the CRI-Off task and a higher overall score, despite the specialization. For non-CRI-Off tasks, one path is zero-padded, effectively deactivating it.
